findings.why_it_matters: The statement clause and its first two subclauses sit one level too deep: every sibling statement uses '## 6.n THE ... STATEMENT' and '### 6.n.m' (6.16 IF, 6.17 INITIALIZE on page 324, 6.19 MOVE), and the INSPECT clause's own later subclauses 6.18.4 (page 328) and 6.18.5 (page 332) are at ###. The outline makes 6.18 a child of 6.17 and splits 6.18.1/6.18.2 from 6.18.4/6.18.5.
findings.note: Should be '## 6.18 THE INSPECT STATEMENT', '### 6.18.1 Function', '### 6.18.2 General Format'.

findings.why_it_matters: The subclause heading is transcribed as a plain paragraph, so a heading-based slicer finds no Syntax Rules subclause for INSPECT; its syntax rules (1)-(9) fall under 6.18.2 General Format.
findings.note: Its siblings are '### 6.18.4 General Rules' (page 328) and '### 6.18.5 Examples' (page 332); it should be '### 6.18.3 Syntax Rules'.
